name: The Millennium
overview: Scripture reveals the Millennium as a future, divinely established kingdom where Christ, the promised Son from the line of Jesse, will reign with perfect justice and peace. Isaiah foretells this era with the birth of the Wonderful Counselor and Prince of Peace who will rule with everlasting authority (Isaiah 9:6; 11:1). Daniel further describes this kingdom as one set up by God that will never be destroyed, where dominion is given to the saints and all realms will serve Him (Daniel 2:44; 7:27), highlighting the eternal and sovereign nature of Christ’s reign. The peace and restoration of creation during this time is vividly depicted in Isaiah 65:25, where natural enemies coexist peacefully, reflecting the holiness and harmony of God’s kingdom.
